identification: Two boxes of modern Star Wars collectables (Play-a-Sound A New Hope book, Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections (DK), Star Wars Lightsabers and Clone Wars paperbacks, painted resin C-3PO bust on grey base, Kleenex R2-D2 tissue box, packaged Darth Vader mask/costume pieces, framed character strip) plus a Bolex Paillard 18-5 8mm (standard 8) film projector, 240V, early 1960s Swiss, and a grey slide viewer/storage unit with clear lid and bulb (lot says 'vintage projector'; a Leica/Leitz-style red logo is on a slide box behind). Star Wars items are 1990s-2000s mass-market; the Bolex is the most identifiable item.
